newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Low grown teas ease at Colombo auction on quality.
newsitem.headline: Low grown teas ease at Colombo auction on quality.

text.p: Prices of low grown teas, the mainstay of the Colombo auction, eased on Wednesday, mainly on lower quality, brokers said.

This was despite good demand from the Commonwealth of Independent States and the Middle East. "Poor leaf low growns were a little irregular but there is no indication of slackening of demand," said an official at brokers Forbes and Walker.

Forbes and Walker said the anticipated gross auction average price for the 4.3 million kg on offer should fall to 118.50 rupees ($2.09) per kg from 119.08 rupees last week. The next auction is on October 8-9 where 4.3 million kg will be on offer.
